reason: ACHV is a contractor too and I don't want a competitor on my site or seeing my programme. On houses and small blocks, glazing damage is cheap to fix or I tape and cover the frames myself, so I can't see a new budget line and a new supplier being worth it.
objection: A competitor on my site seeing my programme and my clients, and 19 euro per m2 coming straight off my margin on a small job.
instead: Keep taping and covering frames with cheap protection film and cleaning up at handover, and absorb the odd replacement.
would_change_my_mind: Supply-only product from a neutral distributor, no ACHV staff on my site, with a short trial on one of my own frames showing it saves more than it costs.
